positions.description: Keil C programming, Hardware engineer, printed circuit board design

positions.title: Technical Artist
positions.description: Innovative CNC artwork and mechanical engineering designs

positions.title: Embedded System Design Engineer
positions.description:
Consult, develop and design team and solo projects including Realtime Kinetic GPS, lawnmower drones and ultralight avionics in a community-driven maker shop. 
Build platforms using embedded firmware design using PIC18, PIC24, dsPIC33/30, Cortex M0/M3/M4, DSP microcontrollers
Develop Firmware
Design and develop layouts for hardware boards
Integrated sensors and applied sensor fusion to lawnmower drone design
Communicate with customers and clients to determine technical requirements in order to produce user-friendly designs
Engineered CNC router with innovative lightweight 4x4 aluminum box and hardened steel edging to create low-cost, high-stiffness gantry design
Developed and designed an ultralight aircraft dashboard, including electrical circuit design and LCD display
Led an effort to find, acquire, and fully refurbish a salvaged ULS production laser cutter, including troubleshooting, creative problem-solving and successfully pitching investors while managing possible risks and outcomes
C development, MPLAB, Keil, PCB design, power management I2C, serial, SPI, ADC
Customer-facing communications, team building, fund raising

positions.title: Senior Hardware Verification Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for testbench plan, testbench generation, and complete verification of central router ASIC for mesh networking of 32-bit AMD K8 server processors.
Applied Cache Coherency Protocol checking to the system to ensure consistency
Debugged Verilog, Vera/System Verilog code
Wrote verification test bench for HyperTransport Link
Wrote verification test bench for external noise-tolerant SeDes version of a HyperTransport Link 
Vera System/Verilog, Testplan Development, Testbench Development

positions.title: Corporate Applications Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for supporting Synopsys Vera (now System Verilog) verification tool on Verilog RTL.
Developed and supported Synopsys Vera verification tool on Verilog RTL
Provided phone, email and on site customer application support for Synopsys Vera/Verilog
Debugged and made features suggestions for System Vera (now System Verilog) based on customer feedback
Vera, Verilog, System Verilog customer communication skills

positions.title: Formal Verification and Analysis
positions.description:
Responsible for performing formal verifications and analsys on M*Core RISC processors for Motorola cell phones.
Analyzed Finite State Machines
Checked equivalencies on custom Verilog RTL against gates
Performed Design Rule Checking on custom gates for M*Core processors
Created and developed test benches
Testplan Development, Testbench Development, Verilog, Perl scripting

positions.title: Hardware Verification Engineer
positions.description:
Performed on-site verification of Motorola's QADC64 module
Created and developed test benches and test plans
Testplan Development, Testbench Development, Verilog, Perl scripting

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and troubleshot automated test devices for telecommunications equipment
Wrote technical documentation for test and calibration procedures for ISO 9002 compliance
Technical documentation, board-level design/debug/repair
